questions.question: In the days of the prophet Haggai, what did the people of Judah say about rebuilding the house of the LORD?

answers.text: The time has not yet come
The work is too hard for us
We have no stones to build with

questions.question: Through the prophet Haggai, God asked the people of Judah about their own comfort. What did His question point to?

answers.text: Living in paneled houses while His house lay in ruins
Guarding their own walls while His gates stood open
Buying new fields while His priests went without

questions.question: Through the prophet Haggai, why did God tell the people of Judah to build His house?

answers.text: So He may take pleasure in it and be glorified
So the priests can live in it and be safe
So the governor can rule from it in peace
